remarks: Classic Charm Meets Modern Comfort Near Old Greenwich. Introducing this gracious Center Hall Colonial, offered for the first time. Ideally positioned near the Old Greenwich line with scenic views of Innis Arden. Featuring 3 bedrooms & 2.5 baths, the home showcases a newly renovated kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and fresh hardwood floors throughout. Enjoy cozy evenings by the gas fireplace in the living room, elegant gatherings in the spacious dining room, and seamless indoor-outdoor living via sliders to a private deck and fenced yard. The expansive primary suite offers ensuite bath and an oversized walk-in closet Two brand-new central air systems, an oversized basement w exceptional storage, one car garage, A Rare Opportunity!
